products.name: Titanium Frying Pan
products.tagline: The everyday essential, redefined in pure titanium.
products.heroAlt: VocVoi Titanium Frying Pan on marble countertop

description.short: Our flagship titanium frying pan — pure titanium surface, zero chemical coatings, and naturally low-stick performance. From delicate eggs to high-heat seared steaks, one pan does it all.
description.long: The VocVoi Titanium Frying Pan is where material science meets everyday cooking. Crafted from medical-grade pure titanium, this pan gives you a cooking surface that never leaches chemicals, never peels, and never wears out. Our patented No-Coating technology achieves natural food release without a single synthetic polymer — so you get the ease of nonstick without the toxins. Lightweight enough for daily use, tough enough for a lifetime.

sellingPoints.title: Pure Titanium Surface
sellingPoints.body: Medical-grade titanium cooking surface — no PFAS, no PTFE, no PFOA. The pan's surface IS the pan, not a coating applied on top.

sellingPoints.title: No-Coating Nonstick
sellingPoints.body: Patented No-Coating technology delivers smooth food release naturally — without a single drop of synthetic chemical coating.

sellingPoints.title: 1000°F Oven Safe
sellingPoints.body: Built for extreme heat. Sear, roast, broil, and oven-finish without warping, fumes, or degradation. Stovetop to oven, no limits.

sellingPoints.title: All Cooktop Ready
sellingPoints.body: High magnetic conductivity base works on induction, gas, electric, and ceramic. Lightweight design with stay-cool ergonomic handle.

faqs.question: Does food stick to the titanium surface?
faqs.answer: Our patented No-Coating surface uses precision-engineered micro-ridges to minimize food contact and distribute oil evenly. With a small amount of oil or butter, you'll get smooth, natural food release — eggs slide right off. It's not a chemical nonstick, but with proper preheating and a little oil, sticking is minimal.

faqs.question: Is VocVoi titanium cookware really chemical-free?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. The cooking surface is pure titanium — no PFAS, PTFE, PFOA, ceramic sol-gel coatings, or synthetic nonstick layers of any kind. The pan's surface IS the pan, not a coating applied on top. We provide third-party lab certification for every batch.

faqs.question: Can I use metal utensils?
faqs.answer: Yes. Titanium is naturally harder than stainless steel, so metal spatulas, whisks, and spoons won't scratch or damage the surface. This is one of the key advantages over coated pans.

faqs.question: How do I clean and maintain my titanium pan?
faqs.answer: Everyday cleaning: warm soapy water and a soft sponge. For stubborn residue, a brief soak and gentle scrub with a non-abrasive pad does the job. The pan is dishwasher safe, but hand washing extends the pristine appearance. No special seasoning required — just cook and enjoy.

faqs.question: What's the warranty?
faqs.answer: Every VocVoi pan is backed by a Lifetime Warranty against manufacturing defects. We also offer a 30-day risk-free trial. Cook with it, and if you don't love it, send it back for a full refund.

products.name: Titanium Sauce Pan
products.tagline: Sauces, soups, and everything in between — pure and precise.
products.heroAlt: VocVoi Titanium Sauce Pan with glass lid on a modern stovetop

description.short: The 3-quart titanium sauce pan — precision heat control for delicate sauces, hearty soups, and perfect grains. Pure titanium cooking surface with tempered glass lid.
description.long: Great sauces start with great heat control, and VocVoi's 5-ply titanium construction delivers exactly that. The pure titanium interior heats evenly from edge to edge — no hot spots to scorch your béchamel. The tempered glass lid lets you monitor without losing heat, and the flared pour spout makes transferring liquids clean and effortless.

sellingPoints.title: Precision Heat Control
sellingPoints.body: 5-ply titanium construction eliminates hot spots for even, predictable heating across the entire cooking surface.

sellingPoints.title: Pure Titanium Interior
sellingPoints.body: Medical-grade titanium — no chemical leaching into acidic sauces or long-simmered dishes.

sellingPoints.title: Flared Pour Spout
sellingPoints.body: Engineered pour spout for clean, drip-free pouring — from the pan to the plate, nothing wasted.

sellingPoints.title: Tempered Glass Lid
sellingPoints.body: See-through lid with steam vent — monitor your cooking without lifting, heat stays in, flavor stays in.

faqs.question: What size is this sauce pan?
faqs.answer: The VocVoi Titanium Sauce Pan is 3 quarts (2.8 liters) — the sweet spot for most home cooking. Perfect for pasta sauces, soups for 2-4 people, rice, grains, and reheating leftovers.

faqs.question: Is the lid oven-safe?
faqs.answer: The tempered glass lid is oven-safe up to 450°F. For higher temperature oven use, simply remove the lid — the pan itself is safe to 1000°F.

faqs.question: Can I boil water in this pan?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. The 5-ply construction conducts heat efficiently, bringing water to a boil quickly on any cooktop. The pure titanium surface is completely non-reactive, so even heavily salted water won't affect the pan.

products.name: Titanium Sauté Pan
products.tagline: Deep walls, wide surface — for when dinner gets ambitious.
products.heroAlt: VocVoi Titanium Sauté Pan with a family-style one-pan meal

description.short: The 5-quart titanium sauté pan — deep, wide, and built for the big meals. One-pan dinners, braised dishes, and cooking for a crowd.
description.long: When the recipe calls for more surface area and deeper walls, the VocVoi Titanium Sauté Pan delivers. The wide 11-inch cooking surface gives you room to brown without crowding, while the 3.5-inch walls keep everything contained. A helper handle makes lifting secure, and the matching lid turns this into a braising powerhouse.

sellingPoints.title: Extra-Large Cooking Surface
sellingPoints.body: 11-inch diameter with 3.5-inch deep walls — enough room to brown a whole batch of chicken without overcrowding.

sellingPoints.title: Pure Titanium, No Coatings
sellingPoints.body: The entire cooking surface is pure titanium — no chemical layers to flake into your food, even after years of heavy use.

sellingPoints.title: Helper Handle
sellingPoints.body: Riveted helper handle opposite the main handle for secure, two-handed lifting — even when the pan is fully loaded.

sellingPoints.title: 5-Ply Even Heating
sellingPoints.body: Titanium surface, dual aluminum cores, and stainless steel exterior work together for consistent, edge-to-edge heat.

faqs.question: What's the difference between a sauté pan and a frying pan?
faqs.answer: A sauté pan has straight, taller walls and a larger flat cooking surface — ideal for pan sauces, braising, and one-pan meals. A frying pan has sloped, shorter walls — better for flipping and tossing. The VocVoi Sauté Pan is your go-to for dishes that start on the stovetop and finish in the oven.

faqs.question: How many servings can I cook at once?
faqs.answer: The 5-quart capacity comfortably serves 4-6 people, making it ideal for family dinners, meal prep, or entertaining.

products.name: Titanium Wok Pan
products.tagline: High heat. Big flavor. The wok, reimagined in pure titanium.
products.heroAlt: VocVoi Titanium Wok Pan with a vibrant stir-fry dish

description.short: The 12-inch titanium wok — flat-bottom stability meets traditional wok versatility. Pure titanium surface stands up to the highest heat your stove can produce.
description.long: A great wok demands extreme heat and a surface that can handle it. The VocVoi Titanium Wok Pan delivers both. The wide 12-inch flat bottom provides rock-solid stability on any cooktop (including induction), while the flared sides give you room to toss, stir, and sear. Pure titanium means you can crank the heat as high as you want — no coatings to break down, no fumes, just intense restaurant-quality stir-fry at home.

sellingPoints.title: Extreme Heat Ready
sellingPoints.body: Pure titanium thrives at the high temperatures wok cooking demands — no coating degradation, no fumes, just perfect searing.

sellingPoints.title: Flat-Bottom Stability
sellingPoints.body: Designed with a flat bottom for secure placement on any cooktop — induction, gas, electric, ceramic — without a wok ring.

sellingPoints.title: Pure Titanium Surface
sellingPoints.body: Acidic stir-fry sauces, high heat, metal spatulas — nothing affects the titanium surface. No reactions, no leaching.

sellingPoints.title: Toss-Friendly Design
sellingPoints.body: Lightweight titanium construction plus a long helper handle make tossing and flipping effortless — even with a full load.

faqs.question: Is this a traditional round-bottom wok?
faqs.answer: No — the VocVoi Titanium Wok has a flat-bottom design. This makes it stable on all cooktop types (including induction and electric) without needing a wok ring, while still giving you the wide, flared sides for tossing and stir-frying.

faqs.question: How does it compare to a carbon steel wok?
faqs.answer: Carbon steel woks require regular seasoning, are prone to rust, and can react with acidic ingredients. The VocVoi Titanium Wok requires no seasoning, never rusts, and is completely non-reactive — even with vinegar-based stir-fry sauces.
